entries.label: fmt, check-sql, host+wasm32 clippy, boundaries, and unit tests
command:
set -euo pipefail
  cargo fmt --all -- --check
  python3 scripts/check-sql.py
  cargo clippy --locked -p coda-http -p physician-sample -p boundaries --all-targets -- -D warnings
  cargo clippy --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p physician-app -- -D warnings
  cargo test --locked -p boundaries
  cargo test --locked -p coda-http ingress
  cargo test --locked -p physician-sample --lib demo_session
  cargo test --locked -p physician-sample --lib hosting
  cargo test --locked -p physician-sample --lib traced_ingress_guard_enforces_8mib_body_limit_and_exempts_health
  cargo test --locked -p physician-sample --bin physician-worker worker_config_marks_public_demo_and_registers_demo_practice

entries.label: demo_scale_harness, fanout, and worker synthetic source boundary on Postgres+Valkey
command:
set -euo pipefail
  cargo test --locked -p physician-sample --test demo_scale_harness
  cargo test --locked -p physician-sample --test fanout
  cargo test --locked -p physician-sample --bin physician-worker developer_plan_refuses_a_workspace_with_sources_outside_the_synthetic_practice -- --ignored

entries.label: physician-sample Chromium browser suites (sign_in_states + site)
command:
set -euo pipefail
  cargo test --locked -p physician-sample --test sign_in_states -- --ignored --test-threads=1
  cargo test --locked -p physician-sample --test site -- --ignored --test-threads=1
